evidence: TTIP and trimethyl aluminum /H20851Al/H20849CH3/H208503 /H20849TMA/H20850/H20852were used as the Ti and Al precursors, respectively. O 2 and N 2O plasma was produced by flowing O 2 and N 2O gas into the reactor at 30 sccm, with the application of a radiofrequency power of 300 W during the reactant pulse steps. After each precursor and reactant pulse, the chamber was purged with Ar gas at a flow rate of 200 sccm to remove the remaining precursor and reactant gases.
